name: chainPair_even_hasSum
statement:
private lemma chainPair_even_hasSum {n : ℕ} (γ : ℝ) (k : Fin n) :
    HasSum
      (fun m : ℕ =>
        (((2 * m).factorial : ℂ)⁻¹) •
          (((((-γ : ℝ) * Complex.I : ℂ)) •
              IsingModel.chainPairInteraction k) ^ (2 * m)))
      ((Real.cos γ : ℂ) • (1 : Qubits.NQubitOp n))
proof:
:= by
  have h_even_term (m : ℕ) :
      (((2 * m).factorial : ℂ)⁻¹) •
          (((((-γ : ℝ) * Complex.I : ℂ)) •
              IsingModel.chainPairInteraction k) ^ (2 * m)) =
        ((((-1 : ℂ) ^ m) * ((γ : ℂ) ^ (2 * m)) / ((2 * m).factorial : ℂ)) : ℂ) •
          (1 : Qubits.NQubitOp n) := by
    rw [smul_pow, chainPairInteraction_pow_even, smul_smul]
    
    have hc2 : ((((-γ : ℝ) * Complex.I : ℂ)) ^ 2) = -((γ : ℂ) ^ 2) := by
      ring_nf; simp
    have hpow : ((((-γ : ℝ) * Complex.I : ℂ)) ^ (2 * m)) =
        ((-1 : ℂ) ^ m) * ((γ : ℂ) ^ (2 * m)) := by
      rw [pow_mul, hc2]
      rw [show (-((γ : ℂ) ^ 2)) = (-1 : ℂ) * ((γ : ℂ) ^ 2) by ring]
      rw [mul_pow, ← pow_mul]
    rw [hpow]
    congr 1
    simp [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_assoc, mul_comm]
  have hcos :
      HasSum (fun m : ℕ => (-1 : ℂ) ^ m * (γ : ℂ) ^ (2 * m) / ((2 * m).factorial : ℂ))
        (Real.cos γ) := by
    simpa using (Complex.hasSum_cos (γ : ℂ))
  convert hcos.smul_const (1 : Qubits.NQubitOp n) using 1
  funext m
  exact h_even_term m

name: chainPair_odd_hasSum
statement:
private lemma chainPair_odd_hasSum {n : ℕ} (γ : ℝ) (k : Fin n) :
    HasSum
      (fun m : ℕ =>
        (((2 * m + 1).factorial : ℂ)⁻¹) •
          (((((-γ : ℝ) * Complex.I : ℂ)) •
              IsingModel.chainPairInteraction k) ^ (2 * m + 1)))
      ((((-Complex.I) * Real.sin γ : ℂ)) • IsingModel.chainPairInteraction k)
proof:
:= by
  have h_odd_term (m : ℕ) :
      (((2 * m + 1).factorial : ℂ)⁻¹) •
          (((((-γ : ℝ) * Complex.I : ℂ)) •
              IsingModel.chainPairInteraction k) ^ (2 * m + 1)) =
        (((-Complex.I) *
              (((-1 : ℂ) ^ m) * (γ : ℂ) ^ (2 * m + 1) / ((2 * m + 1).factorial : ℂ)) :
            ℂ)) •
          IsingModel.chainPairInteraction k := by
    rw [smul_pow, chainPairInteraction_pow_odd, smul_smul]
    have hc2 : ((((-γ : ℝ) * Complex.I : ℂ)) ^ 2) = -((γ : ℂ) ^ 2) := by
      ring_nf; simp
    have heven_pow : ((((-γ : ℝ) * Complex.I : ℂ)) ^ (2 * m)) =
        ((-1 : ℂ) ^ m) * ((γ : ℂ) ^ (2 * m)) := by
      rw [pow_mul, hc2]
      rw [show (-((γ : ℂ) ^ 2)) = (-1 : ℂ) * ((γ : ℂ) ^ 2) by ring]
      rw [mul_pow, ← pow_mul]
    have hpow : ((((-γ : ℝ) * Complex.I : ℂ)) ^ (2 * m + 1)) =
        (((-1 : ℂ) ^ m) * ((γ : ℂ) ^ (2 * m + 1))) * (-Complex.I) := by
      rw [pow_add, heven_pow]
      rw [show ((γ : ℂ) ^ (2 * m + 1)) = ((γ : ℂ) ^ (2 * m)) * (γ : ℂ) by
        rw [pow_add]; simp]
      simp [Complex.ofReal_neg]
      ring
    rw [hpow]
    congr 1
    simp [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_assoc, mul_comm]
  have hsin :
      HasSum (fun m : ℕ =>
          (-1 : ℂ) ^ m * (γ : ℂ) ^ (2 * m + 1) / ((2 * m + 1).factorial : ℂ))
        (Real.sin γ) := by
    simpa using (Complex.hasSum_sin (γ : ℂ))
  have h_odd_coeff :
      HasSum
        (fun m : ℕ =>
          (-Complex.I) *
            (((-1 : ℂ) ^ m) * (γ : ℂ) ^ (2 * m + 1) / ((2 * m + 1).factorial : ℂ)))
        (((-Complex.I) * Real.sin γ : ℂ)) := by
    simpa using hsin.mul_left (-Complex.I)
  convert h_odd_coeff.smul_const (IsingModel.chainPairInteraction k) using 1
  funext m
  exact h_odd_term m

name: exp_chainPairInteraction_closed_form
statement:
theorem exp_chainPairInteraction_closed_form {n : ℕ} (γ : ℝ) (k : Fin n) :
    NormedSpace.exp ((((-γ : ℝ) * Complex.I : ℂ)) •
        IsingModel.chainPairInteraction k) =
      (Real.cos γ : ℂ) • (1 : Qubits.NQubitOp n) +
        ((((-Complex.I) * Real.sin γ : ℂ))) •
          IsingModel.chainPairInteraction k
proof:
:= by
  have hsum :
      HasSum
        (fun m : ℕ =>
          ((m.factorial : ℂ)⁻¹) •
            (((((-γ : ℝ) * Complex.I : ℂ)) •
                IsingModel.chainPairInteraction k) ^ m))
        (((Real.cos γ : ℂ) • (1 : Qubits.NQubitOp n)) +
          ((((-Complex.I) * Real.sin γ : ℂ)) •
            IsingModel.chainPairInteraction k)) :=
    (chainPair_even_hasSum γ k).even_add_odd (chainPair_odd_hasSum γ k)
  rw [NormedSpace.exp_eq_tsum ℂ]
  simpa using hsum.tsum_eq

name: supportedOn_exp_chainPairInteraction
statement:
theorem supportedOn_exp_chainPairInteraction {n : ℕ} (γ : ℝ) (k : Fin n) :
    supportedOn (({k} : Finset (Fin n)) ∪ ({IsingModel.nextSite k} : Finset (Fin n)))
      (NormedSpace.exp ((((-γ : ℝ) * Complex.I : ℂ)) •
        IsingModel.chainPairInteraction k))
proof:
:= by
  rw [exp_chainPairInteraction_closed_form]
  
  have h_one : supportedOn
      (({k} : Finset (Fin n)) ∪ ({IsingModel.nextSite k} : Finset (Fin n)))
      ((Real.cos γ : ℂ) • (1 : Qubits.NQubitOp n)) :=
    supportedOn_mono (Finset.empty_subset _) (supportedOn_smul_one (Real.cos γ : ℂ))
  
  have h_cp : supportedOn
      (({k} : Finset (Fin n)) ∪ ({IsingModel.nextSite k} : Finset (Fin n)))
      (((((-Complex.I) * Real.sin γ : ℂ))) • IsingModel.chainPairInteraction k) :=
    supportedOn_smul _ (supportedOn_chainPairInteraction k)
  
  have h_sum := supportedOn_add h_one h_cp
  refine supportedOn_mono ?_ h_sum
  intro x hx
  simp only [Finset.mem_union] at hx ⊢
  tauto

name: supportedOn_conj_chainPair_exp
statement:
theorem supportedOn_conj_chainPair_exp {n : ℕ} {S : Finset (Fin n)}
    {O : Qubits.NQubitOp n} (hO : supportedOn S O) (γ γ' : ℝ) (k : Fin n) :
    supportedOn (S ∪ (({k} : Finset (Fin n)) ∪
        ({IsingModel.nextSite k} : Finset (Fin n))))
      (NormedSpace.exp ((((-γ : ℝ) * Complex.I : ℂ)) •
          IsingModel.chainPairInteraction k) *
        O *
        NormedSpace.exp ((((-γ' : ℝ) * Complex.I : ℂ)) •
          IsingModel.chainPairInteraction k))
proof:
:= by
  have h_left := supportedOn_exp_chainPairInteraction γ k
  have h_right := supportedOn_exp_chainPairInteraction γ' k
  have h := supportedOn_conj h_left hO h_right
  
  refine supportedOn_mono ?_ h
  intro x hx
  simp only [Finset.mem_union] at hx ⊢
  tauto

name: supportedOn_exp_chainPairInteraction_sum
statement:
theorem supportedOn_exp_chainPairInteraction_sum (N : ℕ) (γ : ℝ) :
    supportedOn (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N))
      (NormedSpace.exp ((((-γ : ℝ) * Complex.I : ℂ)) •
        (∑ k : Fin N, IsingModel.chainPairInteraction k)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [exp_chainPairInteraction_sum]
  
  have h_supported :
      supportedOn
        ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N)).biUnion
          (fun k => ({k} : Finset (Fin N)) ∪
            ({IsingModel.nextSite k} : Finset (Fin N))))
        ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N)).noncommProd
          (fun k => NormedSpace.exp ((((-γ : ℝ) * Complex.I : ℂ)) •
              IsingModel.chainPairInteraction k))
          (fun i _ j _ _ =>
            (chainPairInteractions_commute i j).smul_left _ |>.smul_right _ |>.exp)) := by
    refine supportedOn_noncommProd _ _ _ _ ?_
    intro k _
    exact supportedOn_exp_chainPairInteraction γ k
  
  refine supportedOn_mono ?_ h_supported
  intro x _
  exact Finset.mem_univ x

name: supportedOn_cost_layer_conj
statement:
theorem supportedOn_cost_layer_conj {N : ℕ} {S : Finset (Fin N)}
    {O : Qubits.NQubitOp N} (hO : supportedOn S O) (γ γ' : ℝ) :
    supportedOn (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N))
      (NormedSpace.exp ((((-γ : ℝ) * Complex.I : ℂ)) •
          (∑ k : Fin N, IsingModel.chainPairInteraction k)) *
        O *
        NormedSpace.exp ((((-γ' : ℝ) * Complex.I : ℂ)) •
          (∑ k : Fin N, IsingModel.chainPairInteraction k)))
proof:
:= by
  have h_left := supportedOn_exp_chainPairInteraction_sum N γ
  have h_right := supportedOn_exp_chainPairInteraction_sum N γ'
  have h := supportedOn_conj h_left hO h_right
  refine supportedOn_mono ?_ h
  intro x _
  exact Finset.mem_univ x

name: crossMatrix_mulVec
statement: theorem crossMatrix_mulVec (n v : Fin 3 → ℝ) : crossMatrix n *ᵥ v = n ⨯₃ v
proof:
:= by
  rw [cross_apply]
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;>
    simp [crossMatrix, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three] <;> ring

name: cross_cross
statement:
theorem cross_cross (n m : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    n ⨯₃ (n ⨯₃ m) = (n ⬝ᵥ m) • n - (n ⬝ᵥ n) • m
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;>
    simp [cross_apply, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three, Pi.smul_apply,
      Pi.sub_apply] <;> ring

name: vecMulVec_mulVec
statement:
theorem vecMulVec_mulVec (n v : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    (Matrix.vecMulVec n n) *ᵥ v = (n ⬝ᵥ v) • n
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  simp only [Matrix.vecMulVec, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.of_apply,
    Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  ring

name: R_mulVec
statement:
theorem R_mulVec (n v : Fin 3 → ℝ) (θ : ℝ) :
    R n θ *ᵥ v =
      (Real.cos θ) • v + (1 - Real.cos θ) • ((n ⬝ᵥ v) • n) + (Real.sin θ) • (n ⨯₃ v)
proof:
:= by
  unfold R
  rw [Matrix.add_mulVec, Matrix.add_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec,
    Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec,
    vecMulVec_mulVec, crossMatrix_mulVec]

name: R_apply_axis
statement:
theorem R_apply_axis (n : Fin 3 → ℝ) (θ : ℝ) (hn : n ⬝ᵥ n = 1) :
    R n θ *ᵥ n = n
proof:
:= by
  rw [R_mulVec, hn, one_smul, cross_self, smul_zero, add_zero]
  rw [show (1 - Real.cos θ) • n = n - Real.cos θ • n by module]
  abel

name: R_dotProduct
statement:
theorem R_dotProduct (n v w : Fin 3 → ℝ) (θ : ℝ) (hn : n ⬝ᵥ n = 1) :
    (R n θ *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (R n θ *ᵥ w) = v ⬝ᵥ w
proof:
:= by
  rw [R_mulVec, R_mulVec]
  
  simp only [dotProduct_add, add_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul, smul_dotProduct,
    smul_eq_mul]
  
  have e1 : (crossProduct n) v ⬝ᵥ n = 0 := by
    simp only [cross_apply, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.cons_val_zero,
      Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons]
    ring
  have e2 : v ⬝ᵥ (crossProduct n) w = -((crossProduct n) v ⬝ᵥ w) := by
    simp only [cross_apply, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.cons_val_zero,
      Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons]
    ring
  have e3 : n ⬝ᵥ (crossProduct n) w = 0 := dot_self_cross n w
  have e4 : (crossProduct n) v ⬝ᵥ (crossProduct n) w = (v ⬝ᵥ w) - (n ⬝ᵥ w) * (n ⬝ᵥ v) := by
    rw [cross_dot_cross n v n w, hn, one_mul, dotProduct_comm v n]
  have evn : v ⬝ᵥ n = n ⬝ᵥ v := dotProduct_comm v n
  have hcs : Real.cos θ ^ 2 + Real.sin θ ^ 2 = 1 := by
    rw [add_comm]; exact Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq θ
  rw [e1, e2, e3, e4, hn, evn]
  linear_combination (v ⬝ᵥ w - n ⬝ᵥ v * (n ⬝ᵥ w)) * hcs

name: bHat_dotProduct
statement: theorem bHat_dotProduct (k : ℝ) : bHat k ⬝ᵥ bHat k = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [bHat, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.cons_val_zero,
    Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons]
  have := Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq k
  nlinarith [this]

name: zHat_dotProduct
statement: theorem zHat_dotProduct : zHat ⬝ᵥ zHat = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [zHat, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three]

name: euclidean_norm_eq_one_of_dotProduct
statement:
theorem euclidean_norm_eq_one_of_dotProduct (v : Fin 3 → ℝ) (h : v ⬝ᵥ v = 1) :
    ‖(EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm v‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq]
  have hsum : (∑ i, ‖((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm v).ofLp i‖ ^ 2) = 1 := by
    have : ∀ i, ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm v).ofLp i = v i := fun i => rfl
    simp only [this, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
    rw [← h]
    simp [dotProduct, pow_two]
  rw [hsum, Real.sqrt_one]

name: tauVec_zero
statement: theorem tauVec_zero (k : ℝ) (γ β : ℕ → ℝ) : tauVec 0 k γ β = zHat
proof:
:= by
  unfold tauVec layerProd
  rw [Matrix.one_mulVec]

name: bHat_dot_self
statement: theorem bHat_dot_self (k : ℝ) : bHat k ⬝ᵥ bHat k = 1
proof: := bHat_dotProduct k

name: R_preserves_dot_self
statement:
theorem R_preserves_dot_self (n v : Fin 3 → ℝ) (θ : ℝ) (hn : n ⬝ᵥ n = 1) :
    (R n θ *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (R n θ *ᵥ v) = v ⬝ᵥ v
proof: := R_dotProduct n v v θ hn

name: tauVec_dot_self
statement:
theorem tauVec_dot_self (P : ℕ) (k : ℝ) (γ β : ℕ → ℝ) :
    tauVec P k γ β ⬝ᵥ tauVec P k γ β = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold tauVec
  induction P with
  | zero => rw [layerProd, Matrix.one_mulVec]; exact zHat_dotProduct
  | succ p ih =>
      rw [layerProd, layerBlock]
      rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
      rw [R_preserves_dot_self zHat _ _ zHat_dotProduct]
      rw [R_preserves_dot_self (bHat k) _ _ (bHat_dot_self k)]
      exact ih

name: tauVec_unit
statement:
theorem tauVec_unit (P : ℕ) (k : ℝ) (γ β : ℕ → ℝ) :
    ‖(EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (tauVec P k γ β)‖ = 1
proof:
:=
  euclidean_norm_eq_one_of_dotProduct _ (tauVec_dot_self P k γ β)

name: bHat_unit
statement:
theorem bHat_unit (k : ℝ) :
    ‖(EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (bHat k)‖ = 1
proof:
:=
  euclidean_norm_eq_one_of_dotProduct _ (bHat_dot_self k)

name: layerProd_eq_listProd
statement:
theorem layerProd_eq_listProd (P : ℕ) (k : ℝ) (γ β : ℕ → ℝ) :
    layerProd P k γ β =
      ((List.range P).reverse.map (fun m => layerBlock k γ β m)).prod
proof:
:= by
  induction P with
  | zero => simp [layerProd]
  | succ p ih =>
      rw [layerProd, ih, List.range_succ, List.reverse_append]
      simp

name: tauVec_eq
statement:
theorem tauVec_eq (P : ℕ) (k : ℝ) (γ β : ℕ → ℝ) :
    tauVec P k γ β =
      ((List.range P).reverse.map
        (fun m => R zHat (4 * β m) * R (bHat k) (4 * γ m))).prod *ᵥ zHat
proof:
:= by
  unfold tauVec
  rw [layerProd_eq_listProd]
  rfl

name: eb_eq
statement: theorem eb_eq (h : CAR a b d e) : e * b = 1 - b * e
proof:
:= by
  have := h.be; linear_combination (norm := noncomm_ring) this

name: be_eq
statement: theorem be_eq (h : CAR a b d e) : b * e = 1 - e * b
proof:
:= by
  have := h.be; linear_combination (norm := noncomm_ring) this

name: db_eq
statement: theorem db_eq (h : CAR a b d e) : d * b = - (b * d)
proof:
:= by
  have := h.db; linear_combination (norm := noncomm_ring) this

name: de_eq
statement: theorem de_eq (h : CAR a b d e) : d * e = - (e * d)
proof:
:= by
  have := h.de; linear_combination (norm := noncomm_ring) this

name: ae_eq
statement: theorem ae_eq (h : CAR a b d e) : a * e = - (e * a)
proof:
:= by
  have := h.ae; linear_combination (norm := noncomm_ring) this

name: ad_eq
statement: theorem ad_eq (h : CAR a b d e) : a * d = 1 - d * a
proof:
:= by
  have := h.ad; linear_combination (norm := noncomm_ring) this

name: ab_eq
statement: theorem ab_eq (h : CAR a b d e) : a * b = - (b * a)
proof:
:= by
  have := h.ab; linear_combination (norm := noncomm_ring) this

name: ba_eq
statement: theorem ba_eq (h : CAR a b d e) : b * a = - (a * b)
proof:
:= by
  have := h.ab; linear_combination (norm := noncomm_ring) this

name: bd_eq
statement: theorem bd_eq (h : CAR a b d e) : b * d = - (d * b)
proof:
:= by
  have := h.db; linear_combination (norm := noncomm_ring) this

name: number_commute
statement: theorem number_commute (h : CAR a b d e) : (d * a) * (e * b) = (e * b) * (d * a)
proof:
:= by
  have had' : a * e = -(e * a) := ae_eq h
  have hda' : d * b = -(b * d) := db_eq h
  have hdd' : d * e = -(e * d) := de_eq h
  have haa' : a * b = -(b * a) := ab_eq h
  calc d * a * (e * b)
      = d * (a * e) * b := by noncomm_ring
    _ = d * (-(e * a)) * b := by rw [had']
    _ = -(d * e * (a * b)) := by noncomm_ring
    _ = -((-(e * d)) * (a * b)) := by rw [hdd']
    _ = e * d * (a * b) := by noncomm_ring
    _ = e * d * (-(b * a)) := by rw [haa']
    _ = -(e * (d * b) * a) := by noncomm_ring
    _ = -(e * (-(b * d)) * a) := by rw [hda']
    _ = e * b * (d * a) := by noncomm_ring

name: tM_mul_tP
statement: theorem tM_mul_tP (h : CAR a b d e) : (d * e) * (b * a) = (d * a) * (e * b)
proof:
:= by
  have key : d * e * (b * a) = (e * b) * (d * a) := by
    calc d * e * (b * a)
        = d * (e * b) * a := by noncomm_ring
      _ = d * (1 - b * e) * a := by rw [eb_eq h]
      _ = d * a - (d * b) * (e * a) := by noncomm_ring
      _ = d * a - (- (b * d)) * (e * a) := by rw [db_eq h]
      _ = d * a + b * ((d * e) * a) := by noncomm_ring
      _ = d * a + b * ((- (e * d)) * a) := by rw [de_eq h]
      _ = d * a - (b * e) * (d * a) := by noncomm_ring
      _ = d * a - (1 - e * b) * (d * a) := by rw [be_eq h]
      _ = d * a - (d * a) + (e * b) * (d * a) := by noncomm_ring
      _ = (e * b) * (d * a) := by noncomm_ring
  rw [key, ← number_commute h]

name: tP_mul_tP
statement: theorem tP_mul_tP (h : CAR a b d e) : (b * a) * (b * a) = 0
proof:
:= by
  calc b * a * (b * a) = b * (a * b) * a := by noncomm_ring
    _ = b * (-(b * a)) * a := by rw [ab_eq h]
    _ = -((b * b) * (a * a)) := by noncomm_ring
    _ = 0 := by rw [h.aa, h.bb]; noncomm_ring

name: tM_mul_tM
statement: theorem tM_mul_tM (h : CAR a b d e) : (d * e) * (d * e) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hed : e * d = -(d * e) := by have := h.de; linear_combination (norm := noncomm_ring) this
  calc d * e * (d * e) = d * (e * d) * e := by noncomm_ring
    _ = d * (-(d * e)) * e := by rw [hed]
    _ = -((d * d) * (e * e)) := by noncomm_ring
    _ = 0 := by rw [h.dd, h.ee]; noncomm_ring

name: nK_idem
statement: theorem nK_idem (h : CAR a b d e) : (d * a) * (d * a) = d * a
proof:
:= by
  calc (d * a) * (d * a) = d * (a * d) * a := by noncomm_ring
    _ = d * (1 - d * a) * a := by rw [ad_eq h]
    _ = d * a - (d * d) * (a * a) := by noncomm_ring
    _ = d * a := by rw [h.dd, h.aa]; noncomm_ring

name: nMK_idem
statement: theorem nMK_idem (h : CAR a b d e) : (e * b) * (e * b) = e * b
proof:
:= by
  calc (e * b) * (e * b) = e * (b * e) * b := by noncomm_ring
    _ = e * (1 - e * b) * b := by rw [be_eq h]
    _ = e * b - (e * e) * (b * b) := by noncomm_ring
    _ = e * b := by rw [h.ee, h.bb]; noncomm_ring

name: tP_mul_tM
statement:
theorem tP_mul_tM (h : CAR a b d e) :
    (b * a) * (d * e) = (1 - d * a) * (1 - e * b)
proof:
:= by
  have key : b * a * (d * e) = (1 - e * b) * (1 - d * a) := by
    calc b * a * (d * e)
        = b * (a * d) * e := by noncomm_ring
      _ = b * (1 - d * a) * e := by rw [ad_eq h]
      _ = (b * e) - (b * d) * (a * e) := by noncomm_ring
      _ = (b * e) - (-(d * b)) * (a * e) := by rw [bd_eq h]
      _ = (b * e) + d * ((b * a) * e) := by noncomm_ring
      _ = (b * e) + d * ((-(a * b)) * e) := by rw [ba_eq h]
      _ = (b * e) - (d * a) * (b * e) := by noncomm_ring
      _ = (1 - e * b) - (d * a) * (1 - e * b) := by rw [be_eq h]
      _ = 1 - e * b - d * a + (d * a) * (e * b) := by noncomm_ring
      _ = 1 - e * b - d * a + (e * b) * (d * a) := by rw [number_commute h]
      _ = (1 - e * b) * (1 - d * a) := by noncomm_ring
  rw [key]
  
  have hc := number_commute h
  linear_combination (norm := noncomm_ring) (-1 : R) * hc

name: tX_sq
statement: theorem tX_sq (h : CAR a b d e) : tX a b d e * tX a b d e = Spair a b d e
proof:
:= by
  unfold tX Spair
  have h1 := tP_mul_tP h
  have h2 := tM_mul_tM h
  have h3 := tP_mul_tM h
  have h4 := tM_mul_tP h
  rw [add_mul, mul_add, mul_add, h1, h3, h4, h2]
  noncomm_ring

name: tZ_sq
statement: theorem tZ_sq (h : CAR a b d e) : tZ a b d e * tZ a b d e = Spair a b d e
proof:
:= by
  unfold tZ Spair
  have hidem1 := nK_idem h
  have hidem2 := nMK_idem h
  have hc := number_commute h
  have hexp : (1 - d * a - e * b) * (1 - d * a - e * b)
      = 1 - 2 • (d * a) - 2 • (e * b) + (d * a) * (d * a) + (e * b) * (e * b)
        + (d * a) * (e * b) + (e * b) * (d * a) := by noncomm_ring
  rw [hexp, hidem1, hidem2, ← hc]
  noncomm_ring

name: Spair_eq
statement:
theorem Spair_eq :
    Spair a b d e = 1 - d * a - e * b + 2 • ((d * a) * (e * b))
proof:
:= by
  unfold Spair
  rw [two_smul]
  noncomm_ring

name: nK_mul_tP
statement: theorem nK_mul_tP (h : CAR a b d e) : (d * a) * (b * a) = 0
proof:
:= by
  calc (d * a) * (b * a) = d * (a * b) * a := by noncomm_ring
    _ = d * (-(b * a)) * a := by rw [ab_eq h]
    _ = -(d * b) * (a * a) := by noncomm_ring
    _ = 0 := by rw [h.aa]; noncomm_ring

name: nK_mul_tM
statement: theorem nK_mul_tM (h : CAR a b d e) : (d * a) * (d * e) = d * e
proof:
:= by
  calc (d * a) * (d * e) = d * (a * d) * e := by noncomm_ring
    _ = d * (1 - d * a) * e := by rw [ad_eq h]
    _ = d * e - (d * d) * (a * e) := by noncomm_ring
    _ = d * e := by rw [h.dd]; noncomm_ring

name: nMK_mul_tP
statement: theorem nMK_mul_tP (h : CAR a b d e) : (e * b) * (b * a) = 0
proof:
:= by
  calc (e * b) * (b * a) = e * (b * b) * a := by noncomm_ring
    _ = 0 := by rw [h.bb]; noncomm_ring

name: nMK_mul_tM
statement: theorem nMK_mul_tM (h : CAR a b d e) : (e * b) * (d * e) = d * e
proof:
:= by
  calc (e * b) * (d * e) = e * (b * d) * e := by noncomm_ring
    _ = e * (-(d * b)) * e := by rw [bd_eq h]
    _ = -(e * d) * (b * e) := by noncomm_ring
    _ = -(e * d) * (1 - e * b) := by rw [be_eq h]
    _ = -(e * d) + (e * d) * (e * b) := by noncomm_ring
    _ = -(e * d) + e * (d * e) * b := by noncomm_ring
    _ = -(e * d) + e * (-(e * d)) * b := by rw [de_eq h]
    _ = -(e * d) - (e * e) * (d * b) := by noncomm_ring
    _ = -(e * d) := by rw [h.ee]; noncomm_ring
    _ = d * e := by rw [de_eq h]

name: tP_mul_nK
statement: theorem tP_mul_nK (h : CAR a b d e) : (b * a) * (d * a) = b * a
proof:
:= by
  calc (b * a) * (d * a) = b * (a * d) * a := by noncomm_ring
    _ = b * (1 - d * a) * a := by rw [ad_eq h]
    _ = b * a - (b * d) * (a * a) := by noncomm_ring
    _ = b * a := by rw [h.aa]; noncomm_ring

name: tP_mul_nMK
statement: theorem tP_mul_nMK (h : CAR a b d e) : (b * a) * (e * b) = b * a
proof:
:= by
  calc (b * a) * (e * b) = b * (a * e) * b := by noncomm_ring
    _ = b * (-(e * a)) * b := by rw [ae_eq h]
    _ = -(b * e) * (a * b) := by noncomm_ring
    _ = -(b * e) * (-(b * a)) := by rw [ab_eq h]
    _ = (b * e) * (b * a) := by noncomm_ring
    _ = (1 - e * b) * (b * a) := by rw [be_eq h]
    _ = b * a - e * (b * b) * a := by noncomm_ring
    _ = b * a := by rw [h.bb]; noncomm_ring

name: tM_mul_nK
statement: theorem tM_mul_nK (h : CAR a b d e) : (d * e) * (d * a) = 0
proof:
:= by
  calc (d * e) * (d * a) = d * (e * d) * a := by noncomm_ring
    _ = d * (-(d * e)) * a := by
          rw [show e * d = -(d * e) by have := h.de; linear_combination (norm := noncomm_ring) this]
    _ = -(d * d) * (e * a) := by noncomm_ring
    _ = 0 := by rw [h.dd]; noncomm_ring

name: tM_mul_nMK
statement: theorem tM_mul_nMK (h : CAR a b d e) : (d * e) * (e * b) = 0
proof:
:= by
  calc (d * e) * (e * b) = d * (e * e) * b := by noncomm_ring
    _ = 0 := by rw [h.ee]; noncomm_ring

name: tY_sq_neg
statement: theorem tY_sq_neg (h : CAR a b d e) : tY a b d e * tY a b d e = - Spair a b d e
proof:
:= by
  unfold tY Spair
  have h1 := tP_mul_tP h
  have h2 := tM_mul_tM h
  have h3 := tP_mul_tM h
  have h4 := tM_mul_tP h
  rw [sub_mul, mul_sub, mul_sub, h1, h3, h4, h2]
  noncomm_ring

name: tX_mul_tY
statement: theorem tX_mul_tY (h : CAR a b d e) : tX a b d e * tY a b d e = - tZ a b d e
proof:
:= by
  unfold tX tY tZ
  have h1 := tP_mul_tP h
  have h2 := tM_mul_tM h
  have h3 := tP_mul_tM h
  have h4 := tM_mul_tP h
  rw [add_mul, mul_sub, mul_sub, h1, h3, h4, h2]
  noncomm_ring

name: tY_mul_tX
statement: theorem tY_mul_tX (h : CAR a b d e) : tY a b d e * tX a b d e = tZ a b d e
proof:
:= by
  unfold tX tY tZ
  have h1 := tP_mul_tP h
  have h2 := tM_mul_tM h
  have h3 := tP_mul_tM h
  have h4 := tM_mul_tP h
  rw [sub_mul, mul_add, mul_add, h1, h3, h4, h2]
  noncomm_ring

name: tZ_mul_tX
statement: theorem tZ_mul_tX (h : CAR a b d e) : tZ a b d e * tX a b d e = tY a b d e
proof:
:= by
  unfold tX tY tZ
  rw [show (1 - d * a - e * b) = 1 - (d * a) - (e * b) from rfl]
  rw [sub_mul, sub_mul, one_mul, mul_add, mul_add, nK_mul_tP h, nK_mul_tM h,
    nMK_mul_tP h, nMK_mul_tM h]
  noncomm_ring

name: tX_mul_tZ
statement: theorem tX_mul_tZ (h : CAR a b d e) : tX a b d e * tZ a b d e = - tY a b d e
proof:
:= by
  unfold tX tY tZ
  rw [mul_sub, mul_sub, mul_one, add_mul, add_mul, tP_mul_nK h, tP_mul_nMK h,
    tM_mul_nK h, tM_mul_nMK h]
  noncomm_ring

name: tZ_mul_tY
statement: theorem tZ_mul_tY (h : CAR a b d e) : tZ a b d e * tY a b d e = tX a b d e
proof:
:= by
  unfold tX tY tZ
  rw [sub_mul, sub_mul, one_mul, mul_sub, mul_sub, nK_mul_tP h, nK_mul_tM h,
    nMK_mul_tP h, nMK_mul_tM h]
  noncomm_ring

name: tY_mul_tZ
statement: theorem tY_mul_tZ (h : CAR a b d e) : tY a b d e * tZ a b d e = - tX a b d e
proof:
:= by
  unfold tX tY tZ
  rw [mul_sub, mul_sub, mul_one, sub_mul, sub_mul, tP_mul_nK h, tP_mul_nMK h,
    tM_mul_nK h, tM_mul_nMK h]
  noncomm_ring

name: Spair_mul_tP
statement: theorem Spair_mul_tP (h : CAR a b d e) : Spair a b d e * (b * a) = b * a
proof:
:= by
  rw [Spair_eq, two_smul]
  have h1 := nK_mul_tP h
  have h2 := nMK_mul_tP h
  calc (1 - d * a - e * b + ((d * a) * (e * b) + (d * a) * (e * b))) * (b * a)
      = b * a - (d * a) * (b * a) - (e * b) * (b * a)
        + ((d * a) * ((e * b) * (b * a)) + (d * a) * ((e * b) * (b * a))) := by noncomm_ring
    _ = b * a := by rw [h1, h2, mul_zero]; noncomm_ring

name: Spair_mul_tM
statement: theorem Spair_mul_tM (h : CAR a b d e) : Spair a b d e * (d * e) = d * e
proof:
:= by
  rw [Spair_eq, two_smul]
  have h3 := nK_mul_tM h
  have h4 := nMK_mul_tM h
  have h5 : (d * a) * ((e * b) * (d * e)) = d * e := by rw [h4, h3]
  calc (1 - d * a - e * b + ((d * a) * (e * b) + (d * a) * (e * b))) * (d * e)
      = d * e - (d * a) * (d * e) - (e * b) * (d * e)
        + ((d * a) * ((e * b) * (d * e)) + (d * a) * ((e * b) * (d * e))) := by noncomm_ring
    _ = d * e := by rw [h5, h3, h4]; noncomm_ring

name: Spair_mul_nK
statement: theorem Spair_mul_nK (h : CAR a b d e) : Spair a b d e * (d * a) = (d * a) * (e * b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Spair_eq, two_smul]
  have i1 := nK_idem h
  have hc := number_commute h
  have h6 : (e * b) * (d * a) = (d * a) * (e * b) := hc.symm
  have h7 : (d * a) * ((e * b) * (d * a)) = (d * a) * (e * b) := by
    rw [h6, ← mul_assoc, i1]
  calc (1 - d * a - e * b + ((d * a) * (e * b) + (d * a) * (e * b))) * (d * a)
      = d * a - (d * a) * (d * a) - (e * b) * (d * a)
        + ((d * a) * ((e * b) * (d * a)) + (d * a) * ((e * b) * (d * a))) := by noncomm_ring
    _ = (d * a) * (e * b) := by rw [h7, i1, h6]; noncomm_ring

name: Spair_mul_nMK
statement: theorem Spair_mul_nMK (h : CAR a b d e) : Spair a b d e * (e * b) = (d * a) * (e * b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Spair_eq, two_smul]
  have i2 := nMK_idem h
  have h8 : (d * a) * ((e * b) * (e * b)) = (d * a) * (e * b) := by rw [i2]
  calc (1 - d * a - e * b + ((d * a) * (e * b) + (d * a) * (e * b))) * (e * b)
      = e * b - (d * a) * (e * b) - (e * b) * (e * b)
        + ((d * a) * ((e * b) * (e * b)) + (d * a) * ((e * b) * (e * b))) := by noncomm_ring
    _ = (d * a) * (e * b) := by rw [h8, i2]; noncomm_ring

name: Spair_mul_tX
statement: theorem Spair_mul_tX (h : CAR a b d e) : Spair a b d e * tX a b d e = tX a b d e
proof:
:= by
  unfold tX; rw [mul_add, Spair_mul_tP h, Spair_mul_tM h]

name: Spair_mul_tY
statement: theorem Spair_mul_tY (h : CAR a b d e) : Spair a b d e * tY a b d e = tY a b d e
proof:
:= by
  unfold tY; rw [mul_sub, Spair_mul_tP h, Spair_mul_tM h]

name: Spair_mul_tZ
statement: theorem Spair_mul_tZ (h : CAR a b d e) : Spair a b d e * tZ a b d e = tZ a b d e
proof:
:= by
  have hN := Spair_mul_nK h
  have hM := Spair_mul_nMK h
  have hSeq := Spair_eq (a := a) (b := b) (d := d) (e := e)
  unfold tZ
  rw [mul_sub, mul_sub, mul_one, hN, hM, hSeq, two_smul]
  noncomm_ring

name: tP_mul_Spair
statement: theorem tP_mul_Spair (h : CAR a b d e) : (b * a) * Spair a b d e = b * a
proof:
:= by
  rw [Spair_eq, two_smul]
  have h1 := tP_mul_nK h
  have h2 := tP_mul_nMK h
  have h3 : (b * a) * ((d * a) * (e * b)) = b * a := by rw [← mul_assoc, h1, h2]
  calc (b * a) * (1 - d * a - e * b + ((d * a) * (e * b) + (d * a) * (e * b)))
      = b * a - (b * a) * (d * a) - (b * a) * (e * b)
        + ((b * a) * ((d * a) * (e * b)) + (b * a) * ((d * a) * (e * b))) := by noncomm_ring
    _ = b * a := by rw [h1, h2, h3]; noncomm_ring

name: tM_mul_Spair
statement: theorem tM_mul_Spair (h : CAR a b d e) : (d * e) * Spair a b d e = d * e
proof:
:= by
  rw [Spair_eq, two_smul]
  have h1 := tM_mul_nK h
  have h2 := tM_mul_nMK h
  have h3 : (d * e) * ((d * a) * (e * b)) = 0 := by rw [← mul_assoc, h1, zero_mul]
  calc (d * e) * (1 - d * a - e * b + ((d * a) * (e * b) + (d * a) * (e * b)))
      = d * e - (d * e) * (d * a) - (d * e) * (e * b)
        + ((d * e) * ((d * a) * (e * b)) + (d * e) * ((d * a) * (e * b))) := by noncomm_ring
    _ = d * e := by rw [h1, h2, h3]; noncomm_ring

name: nK_mul_Spair
statement: theorem nK_mul_Spair (h : CAR a b d e) : (d * a) * Spair a b d e = (d * a) * (e * b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Spair_eq, two_smul]
  have i1 := nK_idem h
  have h7 : (d * a) * ((d * a) * (e * b)) = (d * a) * (e * b) := by rw [← mul_assoc, i1]
  calc (d * a) * (1 - d * a - e * b + ((d * a) * (e * b) + (d * a) * (e * b)))
      = d * a - (d * a) * (d * a) - (d * a) * (e * b)
        + ((d * a) * ((d * a) * (e * b)) + (d * a) * ((d * a) * (e * b))) := by noncomm_ring
    _ = (d * a) * (e * b) := by rw [i1, h7]; noncomm_ring

name: nMK_mul_Spair
statement: theorem nMK_mul_Spair (h : CAR a b d e) : (e * b) * Spair a b d e = (d * a) * (e * b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Spair_eq, two_smul]
  have i2 := nMK_idem h
  have hc := number_commute h
  have h8 : (e * b) * (d * a) = (d * a) * (e * b) := hc.symm
  have h9 : (e * b) * ((d * a) * (e * b)) = (d * a) * (e * b) := by
    rw [← mul_assoc, h8, mul_assoc, i2]
  calc (e * b) * (1 - d * a - e * b + ((d * a) * (e * b) + (d * a) * (e * b)))
      = e * b - (e * b) * (d * a) - (e * b) * (e * b)
        + ((e * b) * ((d * a) * (e * b)) + (e * b) * ((d * a) * (e * b))) := by noncomm_ring
    _ = (d * a) * (e * b) := by rw [i2, h8, h9]; noncomm_ring

name: tX_mul_Spair
statement: theorem tX_mul_Spair (h : CAR a b d e) : tX a b d e * Spair a b d e = tX a b d e
proof:
:= by
  unfold tX; rw [add_mul, tP_mul_Spair h, tM_mul_Spair h]

name: tY_mul_Spair
statement: theorem tY_mul_Spair (h : CAR a b d e) : tY a b d e * Spair a b d e = tY a b d e
proof:
:= by
  unfold tY; rw [sub_mul, tP_mul_Spair h, tM_mul_Spair h]

name: tZ_mul_Spair
statement: theorem tZ_mul_Spair (h : CAR a b d e) : tZ a b d e * Spair a b d e = tZ a b d e
proof:
:= by
  have hN := nK_mul_Spair h
  have hM := nMK_mul_Spair h
  have hSeq := Spair_eq (a := a) (b := b) (d := d) (e := e)
  unfold tZ
  rw [sub_mul, sub_mul, one_mul, hN, hM, hSeq, two_smul]
  noncomm_ring

name: carPair
statement:
theorem carPair (P : ℕ) (n : Fin P) :
    PauliKernel.CAR (cAnnihK P (waveVectorABC P n)) (cAnnihK P (-(waveVectorABC P n)))
      (cCreateK P (waveVectorABC P n)) (cCreateK P (-(waveVectorABC P n)))
proof:
:= by
  set k := waveVectorABC P n with hk
  have hcast1 : ((k : ℝ) : ℂ) - ((-k : ℝ) : ℂ) = (((k : ℝ) - (-k : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    rw [Complex.ofReal_sub]
  have hcast2 : ((-k : ℝ) : ℂ) - ((k : ℝ) : ℂ) = (((-k : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    rw [Complex.ofReal_sub]
  refine
    { aa := cAnnihK_mul_self P k
      bb := cAnnihK_mul_self P (-k)
      dd := cCreateK_mul_self P k
      ee := cCreateK_mul_self P (-k)
      ad := ?_
      be := ?_
      ab := ?_
      ae := ?_
      db := ?_
      de := ?_ }
  · 
    have := car_annihK_createK_same P k
    linear_combination (norm := noncomm_ring) this
  · 
    have := car_annihK_createK_same P (-k)
    linear_combination (norm := noncomm_ring) this
  · 
    have := car_annihK_annihK P k (-k)
    linear_combination (norm := noncomm_ring) this
  · 
    have := car_annihK_createK_zero P k (-k)
      (by rw [hcast1]; exact exp_within_pair_ne_one P n)
      (by rw [hcast1]; exact exp_within_pair_root P n)
    linear_combination (norm := noncomm_ring) this
  · 
    have := car_annihK_createK_zero P (-k) k
      (by rw [hcast2]; exact exp_within_pair_neg_ne_one P n)
      (by rw [hcast2]; exact exp_within_pair_neg_root P n)
    linear_combination (norm := noncomm_ring) this
  · 
    have : cCreateK P k * cCreateK P (-k) + cCreateK P (-k) * cCreateK P k = 0 := by
      unfold cCreateK
      rw [← Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, ← Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, ← Matrix.conjTranspose_add,
        add_comm (cAnnihK P (-k) * cAnnihK P k), car_annihK_annihK, Matrix.conjTranspose_zero]
    linear_combination (norm := noncomm_ring) this

name: tauX_eq_kernel

name: tauX_mul_tauX
statement: theorem tauX_mul_tauX : tauX P (kn P n) * tauX P (kn P n) = Spair P n

name: tauY_mul_tauY
statement: theorem tauY_mul_tauY : tauY P (kn P n) * tauY P (kn P n) = Spair P n
proof:
:= by
  rw [tauY_eq_kernel, smul_mul_smul_comm, PauliKernel.tY_sq_neg (carPair P n)]
  rw [show (-Complex.I) * (-Complex.I) = -1 by
    rw [neg_mul_neg, Complex.I_mul_I]]
  rw [Spair]; module

name: tauY_mul_tauZ
statement: theorem tauY_mul_tauZ : tauY P (kn P n) * tauZ P (kn P n) = Complex.I • tauX P (kn P n)

:= by

name: tauZ_mul_tauY
statement: theorem tauZ_mul_tauY : tauZ P (kn P n) * tauY P (kn P n) = (-Complex.I) • tauX P (kn P n)

name: tauZ_mul_tauX
statement: theorem tauZ_mul_tauX : tauZ P (kn P n) * tauX P (kn P n) = Complex.I • tauY P (kn P n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tauX_eq_kernel, tauY_eq_kernel, tauZ_eq_kernel,
    PauliKernel.tZ_mul_tX (carPair P n), smul_smul,
    show Complex.I * (-Complex.I) = 1 by rw [mul_neg, Complex.I_mul_I]; ring, one_smul]

name: tauX_mul_tauZ
statement: theorem tauX_mul_tauZ : tauX P (kn P n) * tauZ P (kn P n) = (-Complex.I) • tauY P (kn P n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tauX_eq_kernel, tauY_eq_kernel, tauZ_eq_kernel,
    PauliKernel.tX_mul_tZ (carPair P n), smul_smul,
    show (-Complex.I) * (-Complex.I) = -1 by rw [neg_mul_neg, Complex.I_mul_I]]

name: pauli_dot_mul_dot
statement:
theorem pauli_dot_mul_dot (u v : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    dotTau P (kn P n) u * dotTau P (kn P n) v
      = ((u ⬝ᵥ v : ℝ) : ℂ) • Spair P n
        + Complex.I • dotTau P (kn P n) (u ⨯₃ v)
proof:
:= by
  unfold dotTau
  
  rw [Finset.sum_mul_sum]
  simp only [smul_mul_smul_comm]
  
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, tauVecOp, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
    Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons]
  rw [tauX_mul_tauX, tauX_mul_tauY, tauX_mul_tauZ,
    tauY_mul_tauX, tauY_mul_tauY, tauY_mul_tauZ,
    tauZ_mul_tauX, tauZ_mul_tauY, tauZ_mul_tauZ]
  rw [cross_apply, dotProduct]
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
    Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons]
  push_cast
  
  simp only [smul_smul, smul_add]
  module

statement:

    Spair P n * dotTau P (kn P n) u = dotTau P (kn P n) u
proof:
:= by
  unfold dotTau
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => ?_)
  rw [mul_smul_comm]
  congr 1
  fin_cases a
  · exact Spair_mul_tauX P n
  · exact Spair_mul_tauY P n
  · exact Spair_mul_tauZ P n

statement:
theorem dotTau_mul_Spair_any (u : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    dotTau P (kn P n) u * Spair P n = dotTau P (kn P n) u
proof:
:= by
  unfold dotTau
  rw [Finset.sum_mul]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => ?_)
  rw [smul_mul_assoc]
  congr 1

name: dotTau_sq
statement:
theorem dotTau_sq (u : Fin 3 → ℝ) (hu : u ⬝ᵥ u = 1) :
    dotTau P (kn P n) u * dotTau P (kn P n) u = Spair P n
proof:
:= by

name: dotTau_cube
statement:
theorem dotTau_cube (u : Fin 3 → ℝ) (hu : u ⬝ᵥ u = 1) :

      = dotTau P (kn P n) u
